articles.title: String of daring Russian plots is testing Washington’s restraint - The Washington Post
articles.description: A strike on a train that imperiled former European leaders and CIA officers is among a spate of attacks that risked a dangerous escalation with the West, experts say.
articles.content:
An airstrike on a train line that endangered the lives of former European leaders and CIA officers. 
Armed drones in Moldova suspected of stalking the plane of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
